subject: POC trial planning: workload profile & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@acmehealth.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial planning: workload profile & success criteria

Hi Priya / Carlos,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great discussion. As promised, here's a short recap & the next steps to get the POC (two-week trial) scheduled. I've attached our workload intake template and a draft success-criteria doc for your review.

1) Success criteria (draft) — please confirm or add:
   - Latency: p50 < 250ms, p95 < 800ms for 512-token requests under baseline traffic
   - Accuracy: model responses match current internal baseline for intent classification (we'll define a 100-query eval set)
   - Cost: fall within the budget you outlined (~$6k/mo equivalent for production)

2) Evaluation plan:
   - Week 0 (prep): exchange workload profile + test dataset
   - Week 1: run baseline tests (no caching, quantization as-is)
   - Week 2: optimize (batching, caching, quantization) and run final eval

3) Workload intake items we need from you (quick):
   - Average RPS and peak RPS (numbers and patterns by hour/day)
   - Typical input token lengths (mean, 90th, max) and expected output lengths
   - Concurrency targets and acceptable queueing (if any)
   - Burst patterns: frequency and duration of spikes (e.g., daily 30m spikes at 500 RPS)
   - Any restricted data/local hosting needs (PHI, on-prem requirement)

Owners: I will own overall POC coordination. Ben will own runtime tuning & infra. Neha will support security/compliance items.

Next steps:
   - Priya/Carlos: fill the attached workload template and return by EOD Thu 5/6 if possible
   - Marissa/Ben/Neha: we'll review and propose a kickoff date in the following week

If that's all okay I can lock in Ben's time for a technical kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acmehealth-workload-template.xlsx, poc-success-criteria.docx
From: Priya Sharma <priya@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC trial planning: workload profile & success criteria

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. Quick responses inline and attached the filled workload template (stubbed values for now).

- Success criteria: agreed on latency and accuracy targets. One ask: can we also track throughput (tokens/sec) as a metric for the team?
- Evaluation plan: OK with the 2-week cadence; request that Week 1 includes a lightweight canary against ~10% of production traffic if possible.

Workload intake (high-level provided in attachment):
- Avg RPS: 45 (weekday daytime), Baseline peak RPS: 180, Highest observed burst: 550 for ~12 minutes (daily event at 10:30am ET)
- Input token lengths: mean 120, 90th pct 420, max ~1024
- Output token lengths: mean 60, 90th pct 240
- Concurrency: typical 8 concurrent inference workers, target POC concurrency up to 40
- Burst patterns: short daily spikes (10-15m), weekly overnight batch jobs (1-2 hours) with sustained 60 RPS
- Data: contains limited PHI in a small portion of logs — we will scope examples and coordinate with Neha on masking/encryption

I've attached the filled template: acmehealth-workload-template.xlsx (version v1). Let me know if you need more granularity.

Thanks,
Priya
Director of Product
AcmeHealth

Attachments: acmehealth-workload-template.xlsx

Priya — really useful, thanks for the quick turnaround and the template. A few clarifications and the proposed plan:

- We'll track tokens/sec as requested and include it on the dashboard (Ben will own telemetry).
- Canary: we can do a 10% canary in Week 1. We will require a short maintenance window (15m) to attach the prefix cache and enable continuous batching optimizations — will coordinate exact timing.
- PHI: Neha, can you connect with Priya to define masking/encryption requirements and confirm whether a Private deployment is required for the POC?

Proposed kickoff & timeline:
- Kickoff (technical): Tue 5/11 10:00am ET — Marissa, Ben, Neha, Priya, Carlos
- Week 1 baseline + 10% canary: 5/12-5/18
- Week 2 optimization & final eval: 5/19-5/25

Action owners:
- Priya/Carlos: finalize any outstanding details in the template (ownership: Priya) — due EOD Mon 5/10
- Ben: prepare test infra and dashboard (telemetry for latency, p50/p95, tokens/sec) — will confirm infra checklist by Fri 5/7
- Neha: security checklist (PHI handling, encryption at rest/in transit) — will reach out to Priya by Thu 5/6
- Marissa: schedule kickoff and share calendar invite

I will schedule the kickoff now for Tue 5/11 10am ET and send invites.

Best,
Marissa
